payload.title: CONFIRM root cause of news-ingest all-duplicate drop (ROUTE FIRST — do NOT guess-fix)
payload.bug: Live logs: every pollNews cycle ends `fetched:160 inserted:0 duplicates:160`. ALL ~160 VPS-pushed articles dropped as duplicates; rag_analyses ~empty (~1 row). Silent (INSERT OR IGNORE).
payload.action: Add TEMPORARY debug logging to tryInsertEntry (apps/mcp-server/src/application/usecases/pollNews.ts ~L511-566) and/or the persist loop (~L915). For ONE real push/poll cycle, log per article: {id, source_url, sourceTitle(<=60), isTitleDup, insertChanges}. Emit a histogram into the handoff: distinct-URL count, empty-URL count, max-duplicate-URL count, isTitleDup-true count.
payload.decision_rule: Many articles share ONE identical non-empty source_url => root cause (a') upstream URL flattening (trace pushNewsHandler payload -> news-fetch -> VPS script). isTitleDup:true dominating on distinct-URL articles => root cause (b) title-dedup over-match (fix in pollNews.ts). URLs empty across the board => contradicts current logic (empty/NULL exempt from partial unique index schema-news.ts:49-51 + skip title-dedup) => re-examine live DB index state + accounting.
payload.constraints: Remove/guard verbose per-article logging before any fix commit. Explicit-file staging (git add <path>, never -A/.). No --force/--no-verify/--no-gpg-sign. No git push. main only. Zero foreign files in git show --stat HEAD. Do NOT touch pilot-status-*.json. Confirmation ONLY this task — do NOT fix in the same cycle; PO routes the fix (NEWS-INGEST-2) after the verdict.
payload.next: PO reads NEWS-INGEST-1 histogram -> routes NEWS-INGEST-2 fix to the zone owning the broken URL source -> qa NEWS-INGEST-3 gate -> po close -> ops PROVE LIVE (NEWS-INGEST-LIVE).
